decision.result: W1 is a viable separately scoped first slice after fresh integrated baseline and explicit implementation authorization; full B1/D1 implementation design has two unresolved IRQ-contract blockers.

read_only_review_scope: Read the entire exact PLAN.md and manifest; inspect final S0.4 nine-file identity map and relevant review findings, actual S0.4 polling driver, current public SPI/DMA contracts and common sequence backend/owner, selected-contract projection and H743 DMA topology/selection/emit paths, selected AXI memory facts, System cache/time boundary and local official RM sections. No production/source/index changes, tests, builds, new clone, network, archive or ELF copy.

positive_design_findings.finding: The plan explicitly excludes synchronous drain(), finish_clock(), retain_and_park() and request ownership from asynchronous service. Sharing exact-V/default-trim/clock/divider, one-shot CSUSP command, stopped predicate, CS/SCK pin-control and checked reset leaves is compatible with bounded no-wait service if every leaf has fixed MMIO/CPU work. The current drain and finish_clock contain polling/time loops and must remain on the synchronous polling path.

A new mode-only DMA owner may embed existing wire state without changing nx_stm32h743_spi_state_t or public nx_spi_* layouts/ops. W1 can change only direct leaf calls, avoiding per-byte virtual dispatch. Existing polling cache/profile/mode admission must remain unchanged; DMA-only cache-off/mode0 restrictions belong in D1/D2.

positive_design_findings.area: Finite byte owner and common reuse
positive_design_findings.finding: Public nx_spi_request_t is already a finite whole-CS byte request. B1 should own that request directly once. The existing common sequence backend has validate/begin/advance/cancel/release/stop and owns outer segment loans; selecting it merely to execute one finite byte request would duplicate owner/state. Keeping segmented support unselected until a later real backend implements the common contract is correct.

The exact RX DMA1/Stream2/DMAMUX1 Channel2/request83/IRQ13 and TX DMA1/Stream3/Channel3/request84/IRQ14 plus SPI4_IRQn84 agree with official CMSIS/HAL definitions. Existing H743 UART streams0/1 and requests45/46 remain separate. The new validator must represent exact directional tuples, not independent stream/request sets or a controller-stream-request product.

The explicit hsi64-fixed-cache-off/baremetal/mode0/8-bit/TSIZE1..65535 gate is suitably narrow. source_max65MHz selecting divisor64 for 1.5MHz is conservative; nominal64MHz remains the same-source TIM2/SPI quiet ratio. No cache-on, PLL384, mode1..3, 16-bit, segment, continuous or OS qualification follows.

AXI SRAM [0x24000000,0x24080000) is selected/linker-visible and DMA1 reachable in current SoC facts; TCM CPU reachability is irrelevant. Full actual TX/RX spans, one-byte fixed cells, overlap/protected-storage checks and initialized/live mapped storage remain required. cache_line_bytes=0/provider_domain/alignment1 are appropriate only behind the actual cache-off mode gate; CPU cache-line capability32 is not selected cache policy.

Admission and active cleanup must inspect actual cache state, preserve cache ownership/lifetime, and use the required CPU-to-DMA and DMA-to-CPU memory ordering even when cache is off. A runtime cache fault cannot be repaired merely by observing CCR.DC clear later if visibility/dirty-line ownership remains unknown; retain until an explicit compatible external cache-owner recovery proves it. This is an implementation acceptance constraint, not support for cache-on DMA.

RM50.4.14 and15.3.16 support disabling both DMA streams and observing EN0 before disabling the peripheral, completing SPI stop/quiet, clearing SUSP and SPE, then clearing SPI TXDMAEN/RXDMAEN. A software stream stop may set TC and cannot be treated as successful completion. NDTR0 is not wire idle; P2M completion includes outstanding memory-side transfer work.

RM15.3.20 restricts direct-mode DME to peripheral-to-memory with MINC0. Keeping RX_FIXED DME tests for the fixed-cell slice is correct. TE may clear EN; DME and underrun/overrun FE need not. A FIFO-disabled/direct-mode stream can still have FE underrun/overrun, so owned FE handling remains meaningful.

First cause must stay fixed through cancel/timeout/error and later EOT. Failure byte count0 is conservative and does not promise no partial RX writes. EN refusal, absent stop/quiet evidence, visibility/IRQ refusal and CS/SCK/reset refusal retain request/endpoint/payload and generation-scoped responsibility; CS-high alone is not settlement. Publish only after detaching all references, with no provider request/payload access afterward.

Source declarations and a complete new real target before implementation can produce genuine missing-symbol RED, but that is a contract/link boundary, not behavioral proof. The plan correctly requires a later complete finite success/cancel/timeout/EN-refusal/IRQ program with the external DMA/frame model and the same tests. No arbitrary host stack may be relabeled AXI SRAM; use an explicit model bus/address mapping and real caller bytes.

D1_preimplementation_blockers.area: SPI EOT IRQ consumption versus physical stop evidence
D1_preimplementation_blockers.problem: The plan says IRQs consume asserted level sources and separately requires real finite EOT/TXC or SUSP stop evidence. It does not specify whether SPI EOT is masked or W1C-cleared before task observation. For nonzero TSIZE, TXC copies EOT: clearing EOT in the hint ISR can erase both flags after CSTART has already cleared, so a later CSUSP need not create SUSP. A normal successful transfer can then lose the only finite stop predicate and remain quarantined indefinitely.
D1_preimplementation_blockers.required_plan_resolution: Specify per-vector/per-flag policy before D1 source authoring. Prefer masking owned EOTIE while retaining EOT until task observes CSTART0 plus nonzero-TSIZE EOT/TXC and establishes the quiet stage; clear it only at the defined safe stage. If a different captured-observation design is chosen, define its active-generation association and revalidation precisely. DMA TC/error IRQs only latch diagnostics/hints and may mask/W1C their own exact groups; no IRQ publishes SETTLED or treats software-stop TC as SUCCESS.
D1_preimplementation_blockers.required_oracle: Normal DMA completion raises SPI EOT IRQ before any task service; after the real ISR the task still obtains valid stopped/quiet evidence and settles exactly once. Also cover EOT/CSUSP race and stale pending EOT from a previous request without manually repairing SR.

D1_preimplementation_blockers.problem: The plan requires source mask/W1C readback and rejects tail-chain dependence, yet its failure matrix only says quarantine on mask/W1C refusal. QUARANTINED alone does not stop a still-enabled sticky IRQ repeatedly re-pending and starving the task that is expected to drive recovery. The fallback and its ownership/readback conditions are not specified.
D1_preimplementation_blockers.required_plan_resolution: Define a bounded isolation ladder for each of the three exclusively owned vectors: latch the first relevant diagnostic under the short IRQ/task handoff, attempt only owned source masks/clear operations, verify source deassertion or disable the owned NVIC vector with actual readback/barrier as applicable, then retain request/owner and require task recovery. Define the irrecoverable boundary if neither peripheral source nor NVIC delivery can be isolated; returning into an unbounded interrupt storm or silently clearing unrelated NVIC pending is not an accepted recovery plan. Never use the polling park/drain loop as async service.
D1_preimplementation_blockers.required_oracle: External level model continuously re-pends on flag+enable; refuse W1C and/or source masks and prove bounded handler work plus verified owned-vector isolation, unchanged neighboring enables/flags/pending and retained loan. Exercise the irrecoverable external-isolation refusal in an explicitly retained/reaped fault subprocess if that is the selected platform policy.

required_clarifications_before_D1.issue: The data-path section cold construction reads actual identity/trim/cache/resource MMIO, while the oracle says construction/cold lookup is zero MMIO.
required_clarifications_before_D1.resolution: Name two boundaries: pure static binding/face construction and factory lookup are zero MMIO; generated Platform hardware initialize/start performs the controlled actual reads and later acquisition/rollback. Do not silently force real initialize to be zero-MMIO or move hardware reads into lookup.

required_clarifications_before_D1.issue: Fixed-work helper interfaces and service stage/read-write budgets should be concrete before D1.
required_clarifications_before_D1.resolution: Document per-leaf max MMIO operations and an explicit stop/quiet deadline result interface. No helper time loop, NX_H743_SPI_POLL loop, request pointer, queue, or owner epoch; stopped RX drain max8 byte reads followed by real empty verification, otherwise retain. Revalidate clock/cache/time assumptions after an invalid epoch before starting a fresh quiet guard.

recommended_first_slice.name: W1: shared bounded wire leaves used by existing polling

existing_file_window.allowed_hunk: Replace shared leaf bodies/calls only; retain synchronous polling wait/drain/finish_clock/park ownership and control flow. Effective S0.4 base must be 2bc6e44e... after Root integration.
Select private spi_wire.c only with actual SPI mode selection; no DMA mode/catalog admission.
Add the helper source to each existing target that already directly compiles the polling driver; leave original cases/assertions intact.
Same helper source inclusion for the current high-profile SPI targets; preserve 32/64/PLL profile semantics.
One new h743_spi_wire.cmake include; no old suite filtering or count assumptions.
Add exact H743 private helper source/header payload entries only, over the new integrated RTC/S0 version; preserve all unrelated payload ownership.

explicitly_outside_window: DMA driver or DMA IRQ definitions
mode catalog, SoC DMA resources, schema/IR/factory generation
selected DMA traits, SDK matrix and unrelated RTC files
recommended_first_slice.expected_leaf_shape: Private fixed-work calculation/command/readback functions using explicit existing bindings or existing wire state, direct C calls or small static inline leaves, with no retained owner/request state. Caller controls sequencing and logical lifetime; a physical CS-high helper must not erase DMA endpoint/reset responsibility.
recommended_first_slice.evidence_exit: Complete leaf-contract program with actual S0.4 polling integration, all six unchanged original whole programs and maintained Python module, unchanged ordinary state size, actual empty/selected ARM closure and FlashLOAD/RAM comparison. Report each executed subset honestly; no W1 test/build ran in this review.
recommended_first_slice.authorization_prerequisites: Root completes normal RTC+S0 integration and provides a new exact commit plus allowed window; preserve all old evidence and reconcile own nine-source overlay hunk by hunk without destructive cleanup. D1 blockers do not require adding DMA behavior to W1.

baseline_findings.meaning: Eight planned shared main snapshots are stale against current staged RTC bytes. This is an execution baseline gate already anticipated by the plan, not evidence of a bad RTC merge. Wait for Root actual new integrated commit; do not copy old descriptor/configure/IR/SDK whole files. W1 SPI base must include final S0.4 source2bc6e44e... and its six companion final-map files.

evidence_protection.protection_scope: Read/hash only. No execution, copy, overwrite, compression, deletion or mutation of old ELF/compile DB/cache/XML/raw/gzip/freeze files. New builds use distinct fresh B1 stage names and retained output directories.

resource_assessment.safe_forward: Reuse the existing own root only after the new Root integrated commit and exact overlay comparison, with retained WIP/evidence untouched; no new clone or reset/clean/stash shortcut.
resource_assessment.W1: A jobs1 W1 allocation of25..70MiB is plausible with the observed TMP free but must be remeasured/reserved against the real target closure and memory headroom before execution. Planned600MiB is not an OOM guarantee.
resource_assessment.clean_SDK: Current roughly731MiB TMP free is below the suggested1.2GiB SDK budget; no clean installed-SDK execution or qualification is promised. Reserve/measure separately or report deferred; do not lower the final B1 gate.
resource_assessment.persistent_ELF_archive: Optional8..16MiB compressed retention requires separate Root budget; not performed here.
resource_assessment.target_state_budget: controller<=192B/endpoint<=32B is an unverified32-bit ABI planning target, not a measured footprint.

official_sources_read.qualification_limit: Local source inspection supports the design review only; no new official download, hardware trace, compiled implementation or HIL was performed.
